tools.name: list_decks
tools.title: List decks
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved presentation decks (id, title, brand, dates).

limit.description: Maximum number of decks to return (default 25).

tools.name: get_deck
tools.title: Get deck
tools.description: Get one deck of the signed-in user, including every slide in order with its full content payload, notes and style-pack / accent settings. Call this before any slide edit so positions and current copy are known.

deck_id.description: The deck UUID, as returned by list_decks.

include_content.description: Include each slide's full content payload. Defaults to true.

tools.name: list_print_assets
tools.title: List print assets
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved print assets (case studies, spotlights, e-brochures, adaptor briefs).

kind.description: Optional kind filter: case-study, spotlight, ebrochure, or adaptor-brief.

limit.description: Maximum number of assets to return (default 25).

tools.name: get_print_asset
tools.title: Get print asset
tools.description: Get one saved print asset of the signed-in user, including its content blocks.

asset_id.description: The print asset UUID, as returned by list_print_assets.

tools.name: list_campaign_kits
tools.title: List campaign kits
tools.description: List the signed-in user's saved social and event campaign kits.

limit.description: Maximum number of kits to return (default 25).

tools.name: create_brief
tools.title: Create brief
tools.description: Create a new deck brief for the signed-in user, which can then be opened in the app to generate a deck.

client_facts.description: Freeform notes and facts about the client.

tools.name: list_section_variants
tools.title: List section frameworks and variants
tools.description: Browse the deck taxonomy. Without a section_id it lists every section framework; with one it lists the module variants permitted for that section and their allowed layouts.

section_id.description: Section framework id, e.g. 'SF-06'. Omit to list all sections.

tools.name: list_variants
tools.title: List module variants
tools.description: Filtered catalogue of every module variant. Filter by family, section, brand mode (respects that division's restricted families and preferred modules) or a free-text query. Returns each variant's id, family, name, layout hint, whether the PPTX exporter has a dedicated renderer for it, and a one-line 'use this when'.

family.description: Module family id (e.g. 'MF-03') or a family name fragment.

section_id.description: Restrict to variants permitted for a section, e.g. 'SF-06'.

brand_mode_id.description: Restrict to what this division is allowed to use, e.g. 'bm-tp-legal'.

query.description: Free-text match against id, name and description.

tools.name: get_taxonomy
tools.title: Get taxonomy
tools.description: Discover the system's vocabulary: brand modes (divisions) with their colour tokens, logo slug and backdrop set, plus module families, section frameworks, layout frameworks and narrative archetypes. Ids, names and counts only — use list_variants for module bodies.

tools.name: generate_deck
tools.title: Generate a deck from a brief
tools.description: Run the full authoring pipeline for the signed-in user: narrative strategist section planning, grounded knowledge synthesis, variant selection and copy personalization, then save the deck. Pass brief_id from create_brief, or the brief fields inline. Returns the deck id, an ordered slide summary and the editor URL.

prospect.description: Prospect or client name (required without brief_id).

client_facts.description: Freeform known facts about the client.

brand_mode_id.description: Brand mode id, e.g. 'bm-enterprise'. Call get_taxonomy for the list.

personalize.description: Rewrite copy for this prospect. Defaults to true.

tools.name: search_icons
tools.title: Search icon library
tools.description: Fuzzy-search the curated brand icon library. Returns icon names usable with set_slide_icon.

query.description: What the icon should depict, e.g. 'security' or 'growth'.

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.title: Search knowledge base
tools.description: Search the division-scoped knowledge base (knowledge entries, brand intel, uploaded brand assets) for verified facts, stats, proof points and client references. Use this before writing any factual claim into a slide.

query.description: What you need verified facts about.

division_id.description: Brand mode / division id to scope the search (default 'transperfect').

tools.name: insert_slide
tools.title: Insert slide
tools.description: Insert a new slide into a deck at a given position, using a section framework and a module variant permitted for that section. Later slides shift down.

variant_id.description: Module variant id permitted for that section.

position.description: 0-based insert position. Defaults to the end of the deck.

content.description: Initial slide content object (e.g. { title, subtitle, items }).

tools.name: delete_slide
tools.title: Delete slide
tools.description: Permanently delete one slide from a deck and close the gap in positions. This cannot be undone from outside the app.

tools.name: reorder_slides
tools.title: Reorder slides
tools.description: Reorder a deck's slides. Pass the full list of current 0-based positions in the desired new order.

order.description: Every current position exactly once, in the new order. E.g. [0,2,1,3].

tools.name: update_slide_content
tools.title: Update slide content
tools.description: Deep-merge a partial content patch into one slide of a deck. Only include the fields you are changing. Numeric values (stats, dates, currency) are protected unless allow_numeric_edits is true.

position.description: 0-based slide position, as returned by get_deck.

patch.description: Partial content object to deep-merge into the slide's content.

allow_numeric_edits.description: Set true only when the user explicitly asked to change numbers or stats.

tools.name: set_slide_icon
tools.title: Set slide icon
tools.description: Set the icon on a slide, either the slide-level icon or the icon of one item in the slide's item list. Use search_icons to find a valid name.

icon_ref.description: Curated icon name (e.g. 'Rocket') or a 'pack:name' reference.

item_index.description: Optional — set the icon on content.items[item_index] instead of the slide icon.

tools.name: change_slide_variant
tools.title: Change slide module variant
tools.description: Swap a slide to a different module variant. The variant must be permitted for the slide's section; the layout auto-corrects to a permitted one and content is preserved.

variant_id.description: Target variant id, from list_section_variants for the slide's section.

tools.name: update_slide_notes
tools.title: Update speaker notes
tools.description: Replace the private speaker notes for a slide. Notes appear only in presenter mode and PowerPoint exports, never on the slide.

tools.name: create_share_link
tools.title: Create deck share link
tools.description: Enable read-only sharing for one of the signed-in user's decks and return the share token and absolute URL. Anyone holding the link can view that deck until it expires or sharing is disabled in the app.

expires_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp after which the link stops working.

regenerate.description: Mint a fresh token, invalidating any link shared earlier.
